nodes.title: Athleta is pushing the inclusivity needle forward
nodes.body:
Training style starts with feeling comfortable in what you wear. Inclusive activewear invites more people to find pieces that suit their bodies and the ways they like to move.

Find your fit

Use the size guide and compare your measurements before choosing a new set. Think about support, stretch and coverage, and try a few gentle movements to check comfort.

Build a versatile wardrobe

Coordinating separates make it easier to find the right fit in each piece. Add a light layer for the journey to and from your workout.

Explore more Kinetra training and style guides for everyday inspiration.

nodes.title: The journey from fitness to fashion
nodes.body:
An activewear wardrobe can feel at home in more than one setting. A favorite training set becomes an everyday outfit when paired with thoughtful layers and simple accessories.

Start with comfort

Choose a sports bra, leggings or shorts that feel comfortable for your plans. Consider the coverage and freedom of movement you prefer, then build the rest of your outfit around those pieces.

Add an everyday layer

A relaxed shirt or lightweight jacket adds another styling option before and after a workout. Neutral colors make it easy to mix pieces, while a brighter accent can bring a personal touch to the look.

Make the look your own

Keep the outfit practical for the day ahead. Comfortable shoes and a bag for your essentials can take a coordinated set from a training session to a casual coffee stop.
